scope: Source tree evidence only. No deployed route, authenticated session, physical-device accessibility, signed native build or independent release approval is implied.

nextPages.warning: 26 page files is NOT 26 user-facing URL routes: catch-all pages render many entries from registers and can reject unknown paths.

corporate.evidenceBoundary: Public page definitions and catalogue entries are source inventory. Deployed URL/SHA, page-specific HIG browser/a11y acceptance and product rights are unverified.

portal.evidenceBoundary: Source module visibility or 'existing-read-only' catalogue state is NOT authenticated production availability. Server-side role/session/tenant, MFA and clinical data rights require explicit protected-user acceptance.

native.appleProductType: Swift library candidate, not signed iOS app
native.evidenceBoundary: Source and debug builds cannot prove signed, installed, published, authorized or physically tested iOS/Android products.

acceptancePriority.required: Expanded catch-all URL manifest; deployed HTML SHA; screenshots; WebKit/Chromium; 320px to 400% reflow; keyboard and assistive technology; colour, content, error and consent tests
Actual route + role/tenant matrix; authorized staging accounts; MFA and session testing; no patient or medicine rights assumption; real user journey screenshots and safe logs
App bundle identity, entitlement, signed IPA or controlled TestFlight release; iPhone/iPad matrix, VoiceOver, text size, dark mode, orientation, permission and authentication checks
Signed APK/AAB with eligible release identity; device/API matrix, TalkBack, font scaling, dark mode, navigation, edge-to-edge, session/permission tests
Authorized Quality/Security reviewer checks each platform evidence and N/A decision; owner signs off only after rights, release receipts and rollback evidence
